title: A memory-safety flaw in the key-management request-building component of the library can lead to an… (CVE-2026-126792)
description: CVE-2026-126792 is a memory-safety vulnerability in a library's key-management request-building component. It involves an out-of-bounds write on the heap caused by a fixed-size buffer that assumes a cryptographic key size without validation. Exploitation requires high privilege to control the embedding application's key-management provider configuration. The impact demonstrated is memory corruption leading to abnormal termination of the client process.
